Defined.ClientFlag_comment: Service, Client. Default is Service. Sent in the control field ControlMessage
Defined.C_init_ID1_comment: Reference signals (ReferenceSignals/Ref_P0_*, Ref_P1_*) must be regenerated if this value is changed.
Defined.C_init_ID2_comment: Reference signals (ReferenceSignals/Ref_P0_*, Ref_P1_*) must be regenerated if this value is changed.
Defined.C_init_Dat_comment: 0 to 255. Gold code id that scrambles the payload. Sent to the receiver in the control field (C_init, 8 bits)
Defined.Use_Preamble_comment: 0 or 1. Default is 1. 0 does not attach the preamble for testing purposes
Defined.Use_ControlField_comment: 0 or 1. Default is 1: the control field (Tx/ControlSignals/Waveform_Control_Tx.h5) is inserted between the preamble and the payload. 0 leaves it out (the Rx must then also have Use_ControlField 0)
